app.name: Product Backlog Designer
appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.note: Only changes icons and colors; it does not change the hierarchy or the target ({profile}).
cmp.d: Both backlogs are judged against the same sources. Neither is treated as gold, item counts are not quality and no winner is computed.
cmp.headline_cov: Left covers {l} and right covers {r} of {n} obligations.
cmp.mappings.d: Many-to-many correspondences set by the reviewer, with the reason for each difference.
cmp.note.counts: Item counts are not a quality measure and no winner is computed.
cmp.note.gates: Quality gates apply to a single backlog: audit each side to obtain its gates.
cmp.note.gold: Neither backlog is treated as gold; both sides are measured against the same independent inventory.
cmp.title: Backlog comparison
col.title: Title
data.d: The complete canonical JSON embedded in this report. Codes are kept as in the data.
data.title: Canonical data
enum.classification.question: Question
evo.d: Proposed changes from new source versions and decisions. Identities are kept, nothing is deleted, human edits need explicit approval.
evo.title: Evolution plan
ex.none: No item matches. Clear a filter or search for another term.
ex.order_note: Default order: backlog tree. It is not the tracker rank; * marks a proposed value, ? an unknown value.
ex.search: Search ID, title, criterion or text
ex.select: Select an item to see its details.
fd.title: Findings
gate.g02.sum: {covered}/{total} obligations fully covered; {handled}/{total} handled under G02 (waiting on a question or conflict: {pending}). Handled does not mean implemented.
gate.g08.sum: Of {n} buildable items: {ready} ready, {partial} partial, {disputed} disputed by the reviewer, {blocked} blocked or deferred, {unassessed} not assessed.
gate.meaning.BLOCKED: — it could not be proven with the available evidence; it is neither a pass nor a fail.
gate.meaning.FAIL: — the evidence shows a problem in what was assessed (in an audit, it is a finding about the audited backlog).
gate.meaning.NOT_APPLICABLE: — it does not apply to what was requested.
gate.meaning.NOT_RUN: — it was not run in this run; nothing was proven.
gate.meaning.PASS: — the expected condition holds and the evidence was checked.
gl.denominator.d: The total a count is measured against and where it comes from (for example the independent reviewer's own inventory, not the generated list).
gl.disposition.d: How a source obligation was handled: covered, partially covered, question, conflict, out of scope, superseded or deferred, always with a reason.
gl.evidence.d: The record behind a result: deterministic check, review, source quote, decision. Types are not interchangeable: a test plan is not an executed test.
gl.independence.d: A review counts as independent only when a separate agent re-reads the sources before seeing the backlog.
gl.invest.d: Independent, Negotiable, Valuable, Estimable, Small and Testable: the dimensions used to assess a story, each with a rating and a reason.
gl.mock.d: A local test tracker. A result verified in a mock is never a real publication.
gl.readiness.d: Whether work can be built now. Confirmed by a source does not mean ready: work that depends on an open blocking question stays blocked.
gl.round_trip.d: Publishing and then reading back what the tracker stored to compare it with what was expected.
gl.source_support.d: The reviewer's judgment: supported by sources, justified proposal or unsupported.
gl.title: Glossary
gl.traceability.d: The link from each item and criterion to the source statements that justify it, and back.
gp.G01.purpose: Checks the source inventory, that every member was read, omissions and file integrity.
gp.G01.why: If a source was not read completely, any coverage conclusion may be missing requirements.
gp.G02.purpose: Checks that every independent source obligation is covered or handled with a justified disposition.
gp.G02.why: It shows nothing the sources ask for was left behind; handled does not mean implemented or fully covered.
gp.G03.purpose: Checks IDs, allowed parents, cycles and orphan items in the hierarchy.
gp.G03.why: A broken hierarchy cannot be imported or planned safely.
gp.G04.purpose: Checks resolvable links between sources, requirements, criteria and work.
gp.G04.why: Without traceability you cannot tell why an item exists or what changes when a source changes.
gp.G05.purpose: Assesses value, clarity, size and INVEST for every story, with the reviewer's reasons.
gp.G05.why: Vague or oversized stories cause rework and unreliable estimates.
gp.G06.purpose: Assesses whether criteria describe observable, verifiable and well-represented behavior.
gp.G06.why: Verifiable criteria are the basis for tests and for the definition of done.
gp.G07.purpose: Assesses whether the tasks are enough to deliver the story and whether assumptions are explicit.
gp.G07.why: Insufficient tasks hide work and make a story look smaller than it is.
gp.G08.purpose: Checks relations, sequence, blockers, declared readiness and forbidden cycles.
gp.G08.why: Work that depends on an open decision must not be presented as ready to build.
gp.G09.purpose: Finds invented requirements, exclusions and scope conflicts.
gp.G09.why: Invented scope spends capacity on something nobody asked for.
gp.G10.purpose: Checks capacity, calendar, units, dependencies and assignments backed by data.
gp.G10.why: A plan with mixed units or invented capacity promises what it cannot deliver.
gp.G11.purpose: Checks data representation, hashes, counts and HTML safety.
gp.G11.why: It ensures every output tells the same story and the report is safe to open.
gp.G12.purpose: Checks target, authorization, approval, revisions and publication preconditions.
gp.G12.why: Publishing without explicit approval can overwrite human work in the tracker.
gp.G13.purpose: Checks that the review was separate, source-first and reconciled.
gp.G13.why: Whoever generated the backlog should not approve it; sequential roles of one agent are not an independent review.
gp.G14.purpose: Assesses redundant items with reasons, without penalizing legitimate repetition.
gp.G14.why: Duplicates split work across two places and confuse tracking.
gp.G15.purpose: Checks identity, human changes, versions, decisions and supersession.
gp.G15.why: Work that still demands behavior replaced by an approved decision sends the team the wrong way.
gp.G16.purpose: Checks allowed scope, data protection and that the run used no network.
gp.G16.why: Sources may be confidential: nothing is sent out and outputs do not leak private data.
gp.G17.purpose: Checks types, fields and relations against a known profile or snapshot, and says what was not verified.
gp.G17.why: A local profile does not prove the real project accepts the fields; only a snapshot or a real read does.
gp.G18.purpose: Compares expected and observed IDs, fields, HTML and links after a simulated or real publication, never confusing the two.
gp.G18.why: Only reading back after publishing shows what the tracker really stored; a mock never counts as a real publication.
gx.BLOCKED: The check cannot be proven with the evidence available.
gx.FAIL: The check found problems that need correction.
gx.G01.BLOCKED: Some source members were not read completely; conclusions may miss content.
gx.G02.FAIL: Some source obligations are not covered, or only partially.
gx.G04.FAIL: Some items or criteria do not trace to the sources or to a justified proposal.
gx.G08.FAIL: There are invalid relations, contradictory readiness, or the reviewer disputes declared readiness.
gx.G09.FAIL: The backlog contains scope the sources do not support.
gx.G13.BLOCKED: The review was not done by a separate agent, so independence is not proven.
gx.G17.BLOCKED: No real tracker project was inspected; compatibility is only checked against a local profile.
gx.G18.NOT_RUN: Nothing was published, so a round-trip read-back could not run.
gx.NOT_APPLICABLE: The check does not apply to what was requested.
gx.NOT_RUN: The check was not executed in this run.
gx.PASS: The check passed and its evidence was verified.
header.privacy: May contain sensitive content: share only with people allowed to see the sources.
int.d: Exact fields that a future publication would write. This package was not sent anywhere; no tracker was contacted.
int.profile_unverified: Not verified against a real project
int.title: Integration package (local preview)
it.imported_note: Imported as written; links to sources come only from the independent audit.
it.no_trace: No source requirement is linked to this item.
lang.content_note: Changing the interface language does not translate backlog content, which stays in {lang}.
lang.label: Interface language
m.criteria.d: {proposed} of them proposed (not confirmed by a source).
m.full_cov.d: COVERED over the independent reviewer's inventory. Partial, out-of-scope and question dispositions are counted separately.
m.handled.d: Covered, or dispositioned by the contract (out of scope, superseded, deferred, question). Same denominator.
m.items.d: All items in the backlog, every level.
m.members.d: Files or pages inside the selected sources.
nojs: Interactive features are off; all content is shown below.
ov.audit_note: Audit judges the existing backlog as it is; failing gates are audit results, not pipeline errors.
ov.decisions.none: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
ov.dev_ready.d: Readiness declared by the designer and checked by the reviewer, over {n} buildable items (stories, tasks, spikes, enablers, bugs). It is not the tracker state.
ov.headline.audit: An existing backlog with {items} work items and {criteria} acceptance criteria was audited against {sources}.
ov.headline.compare: Two backlogs were compared against the same {sources}.
ov.headline.generate: {items} work items and {criteria} acceptance criteria were generated from {sources}.
ov.ready.backlog.d: Coverage, hierarchy, traceability, story, criteria, task and scope gates (G02–G09, G14).
ov.ready.integration.d: Target compatibility and round-trip (G17–G18). Not contacting a tracker is expected.
ov.ready.review.d: Separate reviewer with its own inventory (G13).
ov.state.attention: {fail} quality gates fail and {blocked} are blocked; see what needs a decision below.
ov.state.blocked: No quality gate fails; {blocked} cannot be proven yet.
ov.state.ok: The applicable content, source and review gates pass with verified evidence. Tracker compatibility is assessed separately.
plan.d: A proposal, not a commitment: built only from confirmed fields and the inputs you gave. Unknown stays unknown.
plan.draft: Local draft: not a commitment and not published to any tracker. Filters and scenarios do not change the backlog.
plan.mode.story_owner: Mode: one accountable owner per story; tasks may have other assignees.
plan.mode.whole_story_delegation: Mode: whole-story delegation (proposal; tasks follow the owner).
plan.order_note: Backlog position is the tree order (not a tracker rank); the suggested order respects dependencies and readiness.
plan.outside: Work of another sprint done here
plan.prov.planning_input: stated by the user in the request
plan.stale: Stale: the backlog changed after this plan was made.
plan.title: Planning proposal
plan.unknown_capacity: Unknown — sequence only, no sprint promise
pub.d: Exact operations bound to one target. Results below come from the in-memory mock only; no tracker was contacted.
pub.title: Publication plan (mock)
q.decision_note: Answering a question here does not change the backlog: decisions are recorded as source artifacts.
q.title: Questions
qa.d: Each gate is computed by the runtime from recorded evidence; every PASS is re-verified against artifact hashes.
qa.only_pass_verified: Evidence recorded; only passing gates are re-verified against the hashes.
qa.title: Quality gates
rd.independent_of: Related to, but not blocked by
rd.title: Development readiness
rq.claims.d: Atomic requirements reconciled from every reader, and how the backlog dispositioned them.
rq.obligations.d: Obligations the independent reviewer extracted from the original sources, with the work that carries each one.
src.d: Only the sources selected for this run were read.
src.title: Sources
theme.label: Theme
toast.copy_failed: The browser blocked the clipboard: the text is selected, press Ctrl+C.
